routine: C0/8A6D forced/auto-walk ALT path (player controller, DP=$1D00)
summary: C0/8A6D is the "forced/auto-walk" mover. The player controller body at C0/881E calls it (with SEP #$10 so X/Y are 8-bit inside) only when $0120 != 0. It reads the *velocity accumulator* $2E (X) and $30 (Y), dispatches by their signs into one of 8 directional handlers (4 cardinals + 4 diagonals), and each handler does position-based collision "feeler" probing around the actor's real on-map position ($1800,X / $1880,X). Unlike the normal free-roam mover, these handlers operate by computing tentative positions in $66/$68 and testing tiles via the 8A9E prop-test helper and actors via the 9923 proximity helper; on a clear path they fall through to the per-axis apply C0/9C5C, on a blocked path they zero $2E/$30 (kill velocity) and RTS. In the captured trace (boot_trace_play.txt, Crono's room free-roam), $0120 IS nonzero every frame so 8A6D runs each frame, but $2E and $30 are both 0 at this call point (it runs BEFORE 91AC builds velocity), so the top-level dispatch always takes 8A6D->8A6F(BEQ $30=0)->8A82->8A84(BEQ $2E=0)->8A8E RTS and NONE of the deep handlers ever fire. So for byte-exact free-roam this routine is effectively a no-op; the handlers matter only for scripted/auto-walk (cutscenes, stairs, forced movement) where $2E/$30 are pre-seeded nonzero.
dp: $1D00 (D set by LDA #$1D00;TCD at C0/881E; so dp operand $XX = $7E:1DXX). NOTE: entered with SEP #$10 (X/Y are 8-bit) from C0/8847; the body does REP #$10 again at 884A on return. A-width is toggled per-block by the REP/SEP #$20 inside each handler.
wramReads: $1D30 ($30): Y velocity accumulator (signed 16-bit; low byte read 8-bit at 8A6D for BEQ/BMI dispatch)
$1D2E ($2E): X velocity accumulator (signed 16-bit; low byte read at 8A82/8A8F/8A73 for dispatch)

$0120: forced/auto-walk ENABLE flag (absolute $7E0120). 8A6D is entered from 881E only if !=0. In the captured free-roam trace it is nonzero EVERY frame, yet handlers never fire because $2E/$30==0 at this call point.
$0197: player/leader actor index (absolute), used as X into the $18xx position tables
$0199, $019B: companion actor indices (absolute), skipped by the 9923 actor-proximity test
$1800,X ($7E1800,X): actor on-map X position word (base X, -> $62)
$1880,X ($7E1880,X): actor on-map Y position word (base Y, -> $64)
$1D62 ($62): base X copy
$1D64 ($64): base Y copy
$1D66/$1D67 ($66/$67): tentative probe X word / its high byte (high byte $67 fed to cell-mask in 8A9E)
$1D68 ($68): tentative probe Y word (used by 8A9E and 9923)
$1D2A/$1D2B ($2A/$2B): conveyor/momentum (written by the 9C5C commit leaf, not read here directly)
$1D1E/$1D1F ($1E): collision CELL mask (AND'd in 9AA1/9AD3 to form tile index)
$1D58/$1D5A/$1D5C ($58/$5A/$5C): fetched tile property bytes 0/1/2 (written by 9AD3/9AA1, consumed by z-gate)
$1D6A/$1D6C ($6A/$6C): tile z-plane / IGNORE_Z (set by 9AD3 path, read by 9C37 z-gate)
$0155: player Z-plane (absolute), compared in the 9C37 z-gate
$0F00,X ($7E0F00,X): per-actor sprite-present (9923; 0 -> skip actor)
$1100,X ($7E1100,X): per-actor flag, bit7 -> skip (9923)
$1B01,X ($7E1B01,X): per-actor collision flags; bit0 selects SEC-on-hit vs CLC-on-hit branch (9923)
$7F2000: active-actor list count/index seed for the 9923 scan loop
$7E70C0,X: off-map/solid sentinel plane (bit7 set -> off the map -> solid) read in 9AA1
$7E30C0,X / $7E7000,X / $7E7040,X: tile property byte0/byte1/byte2 source planes (9AB2)
wramWrites: $1D2E ($2E): X velocity -- STZ'd on any blocked X feeler (cancels X auto-walk this frame); never set to a nonzero value by these handlers

$1D30 ($30): Y velocity -- STZ'd on blocked Y feeler; ALSO transiently set to constants by slide logic: LDA #$FFF0;STA $30 (8B1C, -$10 nudge) and LDA #$0010;STA $30 (8B4F, +$10 nudge) to round corners, then re-tested and re-zeroed if still blocked

$1D2F ($2F): X-velocity HIGH/sign byte -- STZ'd (positive) for E/Down/Up/SE, set $FF (negative, sign-extend) for W/NW/SW (8BC4/8EF1/8FC1 etc.). This sign-extends the 8-bit motion into the 16-bit $2E word.
$1D31 ($31): Y-velocity HIGH/sign byte -- STZ'd for downward (E/SE/S/Down), set $FF for upward (N/NE/NW/Up: 8BF9/8E21/8EF1)
$1D62 ($62), $1D64 ($64): base position copies (also $66 in up/down handlers seeded = $62)
$01EB: scratch written by 9923 (#$0080 then STX) -- DMA/IRQ guard or actor cursor; saved/restored
$1D58/$1D5A/$1D5C, $1D5E/$1D60, $1D6A/$1D6C/$1D6E: tile-prop scratch cleared/set by 9AD3 each probe

(via 9C5C commit leaf only, on the all-clear path) $0155 player z-plane, $0C00,X/$0C01,X OBJ priority, $1D2A/$1D2B conveyor, and the actor position $1800/$1880 integration -- these are the 9C5C routine's writes, not 8A6D's own; 8A6D itself NEVER writes $1D62/$1D64 position directly, it only feeds 9C5C which integrates pos+vel.
uncertainties: DISPATCH WIDTH: At 8A6D the A register is 8-bit (body did SEP #$20 at 882A and there is no REP #$20 before the JSR at 8847; only SEP #$10 toggles X/Y). So LDA $30 / LDA $2E load only the LOW byte and BEQ/BMI test the low byte's value and bit7. For a 16-bit velocity whose low byte is 0 but high byte nonzero (|v|>=256), this would mis-dispatch -- but in practice the accumulator is 0 here. Verifier should confirm A stays 8-bit across 8847 and that velocities at this point fit in one signed byte.

$0120 SEMANTICS: I did not locate the writer of $0120 in disasm/notes. Empirically (trace) it is nonzero during ordinary free-roam in Crono's room, NOT just cutscenes -- so 8A6D runs every frame but is a no-op because $2E/$30==0 at call time (it precedes 91AC which builds velocity). Confirm: is $0120 a persistent 'auto-walk subsystem enabled' flag (vs a per-event trigger)? If always-on, the handlers fire only when a script pre-seeds $2E/$30 before this frame's 91AC.

FREE-ROAM IMPACT: For byte-exact normal walking, 8A6D contributes NOTHING (always 8A8E RTS in the trace; 0 hits on every deep handler 8AB5/8BC4/8D11/8FC1/909C/8E21/8EF1/8BF9). Recommend the C port implement the top-level dispatch faithfully but the 8 handlers can be stubbed/deferred until a forced-walk test case exists. Verifier: do any cutscene/stairs traces exercise the handlers?

8A9E DUAL SIGNAL: handlers branch on both returned A (BNE/BEQ) and carry (BCS/BCC). I read A=1 (off-map) => carry SET (from 9AA1 SEC), A=0 => carry = 9C37 z-gate result. The 8B02/8C46/8D56/8DA2/8C92 'BNE then BCS' clusters use A to distinguish off-map vs z-solid then carry for the z verdict. Confirm this A-vs-carry split is exactly as decoded (it determines whether the corner-slide branches are taken).

SLIDE CONSTANTS: the +/-$10 ($0010 / $FFF0) writes to $30 (and $2E in down/diag handlers) are corner-rounding nudges of 16 sub-pixels. They are written then re-probed; if still blocked they are STZ'd. Verify these never leak out as residual velocity (they always end either committed via 9C5C or zeroed before RTS).

9C5C COMMIT vs CANCEL: 8A6D handlers reach 9C5C via BRL (tail-call) on clear paths. 9C5C is the same per-axis apply the normal mover uses; I did not re-verify its body here (per task scope) -- it is documented in MEMORY as integrating $62/$64+$2E/$30, STZ'ing on solid, updating $0155/$0C00/$0C01/$2A/$2B. Verifier should confirm 9C5C behaves identically when reached from auto-walk vs free-roam (same DP $1D00, same inputs).
